name: Bauernhof Schellhorn
beschreibung:
History

For the entry Bauernhof Schellhorn in Schwoich there is no retrieved business website with a house history. PocketAustria lists a holiday house Bauernhof Schellhorn, Am Bach 10, and names the postcode 6330 Schwoich. FreizeitMonster names a chalet in Schwoich at the address Am Bach 10, 6334 Schwoich. The map page cartes.app names 10 Am Bach, 6334 Schwoich, the telephone number +43 5372 58203 and the coordinates 47.54712, 12.14530, source geoimage.at. The postcode 6330 or 6334 is not uniform across the directories. The present data set uses 6334 and Am Bach 10 and the same telephone number. A year of construction, the number of apartments or the names of the hosts in Schwoich do not appear on these pages.

The mountain farm of the Schellhorn family on ferienwohnung-schellhorn.at is not the same business. Its About us page describes a farm that was built in the 1930s, whose farm buildings were renewed in 1990 and whose upper floor was converted in 2006/2007 into two holiday apartments, with an Austraghaus from 1997, livestock and the address Sonnberg, Niederau 21, 6314 Wildschönau, telephone +43 5339 8661. According to this source, this history, the animals and the view of the Wilder Kaiser, the Markbachjoch and the Schatzberg belong to Niederau in the Wildschönau and not to the address Am Bach in Schwoich.

Getting there

The only location described in more detail is on PocketAustria: Am Bach 10 in Schwoich, near the entries Ferienhaus Hubmann and Café Tirol. The same page names the bus stops Schwoich Moosham at 399 metres, Schwoich Dorf at 414 metres and Schwoich Bäckerei Schellhorn at 414 metres. Whether the bakery belongs to the same family, the page does not say. A separate arrival description from the business is missing.

Tips

Documented facilities, prices, opening hours or house rules for the house in Schwoich are not present in the sources named. Enquiries can be made via the number given in the directories and in the data set, +43 5372 58203. Anyone looking for the holiday apartments in the Wildschönau must use the address Niederau 21 and not Am Bach 10. As long as no page of the Schwoich house confirms rooms, animals or a chronicle, these points remain open.
kurzbeschreibung: In directories a holiday house at Am Bach 10 in Schwoich. The Schellhorn family farm in the Wildschönau is a different address and is not mixed in here.
